## Graph interface

The declared graph as `g.graph(...routes)` returns it: what the executor and the checker read, and, in its type, the graph's entities, the ctx its runs carry and its routes `R`<!-- -->. `run` checks a run's `ctx` against it and the providers asked against the routes; a runner's `read` takes the entity names and key types from it too. Its routes are not widened by an assignment: a graph of some routes is not one of more. The graph with its types forgotten, a `GraphDef<Meta>`<!-- -->, has any route as far as the compiler knows, and the run refuses a missing one (`HG_NO_ROUTE`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Graph<E extends Entities, Ctx, Meta, R extends AnyRoute = AnyRoute> extends GraphDef<Meta> 
```
**Extends:** [GraphDef](./hopgraph.graphdef.md)<!-- -->&lt;Meta&gt;
